objectives.text: The purpose of the subchapter (except section 5315) is to require certain reports or records highly useful in criminal, tax, or regulatory investigations, risk assessments, or proceedings, or in intelligence or counterintelligence activities including analysis to protect against terrorism.

citations.quote: It is the purpose of this subchapter (except section 5315) to-

(A) criminal, tax, or regulatory investigations, risk assessments, or proceedings; or
(B) intelligence or counterintelligence activities, including analysis, to protect against terrorism;

objectives.text: The purpose is to prevent the laundering of money and the financing of terrorism through the establishment by financial institutions of reasonably designed risk-based programs to combat money laundering and the financing of terrorism.

citations.quote: the Secretary of the Treasury shall revise the final rule entitled 'Customer Due Diligence Requirements for Financial Institutions' (81 Fed. Reg. 29397 (May 11, 2016)) to-

notes: Section 5311 itself is a declaration of purpose and contains no operative modal duty in its body; the only program-establishment content within ratified scope is purpose clause (2) referencing financial institutions' establishment of 'reasonably designed risk-based programs.' It is worded as a statutory purpose, not a directly imposed 'shall' duty, so obligation 5311-OB-01 is coded 'conditional' and flagged: the pillars/program mandate is stated as a purpose here, with the actual operative program requirement located elsewhere (e.g., 31 U.S.C. 5318(h)), outside this source. The numerous statutory notes (AMLA 2020 §§6002-6303, USA PATRIOT Act §§302-359, and older provisions) impose duties primarily on the Secretary/agencies (studies, reports, officer appointments, international coordination) rather than program-establishment obligations on covered institutions; most fall outside the ratified program/'pillars' scope and are recorded as objectives/interactions only where scope-relevant. Definitions in §6003 apply 'in this division' (AMLA 2020), not to §5311 text proper; captured because materially scope-relevant. Purposes note §6002(4) reinforces the risk-based character of AML/CFT programs and is recorded as an objective.
